Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL209. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL209, target type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax ID 9606, standard type IC50, standard relation equals, and pChEMBL value not null. Order rows by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to the first 1000 rows.
